evidence_text: ANL home says it is a non-profit class association that congregates associated bookstores and supports the bookseller market.

ANL public associates page exposes member blocks with display names, website links, addresses, cities/states, and phones; examples include A Degustadora, A Página, Bibla Livraria, Círculo Livraria, Livraria da Travessa, etc.

ANL services/Anuário pages say the national bookstore yearbook provides an updated listing of bookstores in Brazil organized by regions, municipalities, and states; 2023 edition exists but PDF/Excel access is controlled/paid.
Frankfurt 2027 official ecosystem directory page exposes contact-directory download links for editoriales, distribuidoras, and librerías.
Frankfurt 2027 ecosystem context page names major Chile book ecosystem associations and says the book ecosystem includes multichannel sale patterns.
Google Sheets link opens a view-only JS shell named 'Prueba directorio Mincap'; row content was not extractable in this runtime.
CPL directory page exposes static member blocks with names, addresses, phone numbers, and website links; examples include LIBRERIA DEPORVIDA and LIBRERÍA OCULTA.

FIL Lima organizer page describes CPL as a non-profit trade/cultural association including publishers, university presses, distributors, booksellers, installment-book-sales organizations, research/documentation centers, reading-promotion entities, and book clubs; it says CPL has more than 130 members.

CUL Socios page separates member categories General, Librerías, Editoriales, Distribuidoras and renders category labels and names; examples include Amazonia, América Latina, Bookshop, Buscalibre, Escaramuza, Puro Verso.
CUL institutional page says the chamber brings together booksellers, publishers, and distributors and works for promotion and defense of books in Uruguay.

CCL active-members page exposes static blocks with member name, contact person, email, and website; examples include DCC/Librería Internacional, Everything Faith Bookstore, El Librero Pandeado, Librería Lehmann.
CCL Conózcanos page says it promotes creation, production, and commercialization of books and aims to develop/professionalize members and protect book/reading activities.
